content.text: ## Nocturne of Scorpio _dedicate to The Daughter of the Wind_ Big shoutout to the random guy we met down at the Fishermen's Village in Puntagorda -- thanks to him, we actually got this killer shot of us together, featuring LiLi Glitch rocking the design on her shirt. (And yeah, you can snag that exact shirt [right here on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/i/t-shirt/Nocturne-of-Scorpio-A-Fractal-Painting-by-jayaprime/22185838/xmcg)) There are actually three distinct versions of this piece floating around. Two of them are painted variations -- one in striking cobalt, el otro in deep violet -- both built right on top of the final digital render that serves as the foundation for the whole trio. While I was deep-diving into the Mandelbrot set, I threw in a sharp spiral function. It caused every segmented layer to aggressively spike outward, looking almost perfectly like a scorpion's stinger. That effect quickly amplified, twisting the entire double-spiral until it looked like two stingers locked in a deadly, hypnotic dance... descending endlessly downward into infinity. Given how insanely popular this piece has been -- both with the fans and in sheer sales -- most other artists would immediately cash in and say, _"Let's make a whole Zodiac series!"_ I'm not gonna lie, I considered it.. . and then immediately nixed the idea. If the raw inspiration for a specific sign actually hits me one day, I might be moved to change my mind. But until then? This remains a one-of-a-kind beast in three-fold form. \[[Cobalt Scorpio on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/22185838)\]

content.text:
## On Scorpions & Venom

The level of danger and absolute insanity that I seek out in the fires of love has been a source of commentary among others. I openly admit to it myself and take no actions to change it. Yet I would remind those who consider this a detractor: _anti-venom is made from the venom itself._

Scorpions are among my favorite creatures to ever be put upon this planet, no matter whether they wear skin or carapace. That includes legends such as LiLi Glitch herself, Aswini of SESA PURE, Craigers of Camp Mystic, as well as the tornado that is Ramona Mayhem... to name just a few. That last one was featured in my now-legendary article _"How to Properly Issue a Ticket to a Police Officer in 5 Easy Steps"_ ([Original Post on Blogger](https://landloreblog.blogspot.com/2010/09/how-to-properly-issue-ticket-to-police.html)).

There are many in this world who shy away from poison.. . or even anything resembling it. Not this guy. _Daddy needs his feel-good juice!_ ([Sealab Excerpt on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OPSx283jpJE)) I consider them one of the most misunderstood signs of the thirteen great constellations. Not only that, but many don't even want to understand.

Aries is simple. Enough fuel in the car and we'll happily drive it right off the cliff. _Easy peasy!_ And you know what? Scorpions are the crazy ass amazing motherfuckers who, as soon as we finish fueling the car, they're the first to shout, _"Shotgun!!!"_

This design goes out to every single one of you incredible creatures!

## The Emperor Scorpion

The Emperor scorpion is this massive, bulbous, shining black tank of an arachnid. He looks absolutely terrifying, but in reality? That stinger can rarely even pierce human skin. They actually make great pets and are hands-down one of the most fascinating creatures in the entire species.

Don't mistake that for being entirely harmless, by the way... they shouldn't be provoked. They love the heat -- much like I do down here in Costa Rica -- and they'll gladly act as your personal hit squad, taking out any smaller pests creeping around your place.

What you're looking at here is the original, unmodified fractal render that spawned both paintings, cooked up in Ultra Fractal. I deliberately carved out the stingers and mandibles in a deep, brooding violet, contrasting them hard against that sunset-colored stairwell as it spirals down into its own unknown depths.

There's a heavy mythos tied to this one, too. As a symbol and familiar to the Egyptian goddess Serket, the scorpion has always been deeply connected to the guardians -- the ones who ferry souls from the world of the living straight into the land of the dead.

I rarely ever share this design. My patrons got the first look, and naturally, it's available on a few products for the rare souls who feel drawn to it. But for the most part? I consider this one reserved for a select few.

_You know who you are._

\[[Emperor on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/28819091)\]

## Extended Exploration

If you really like the painted style here, then you'll want to check out "[The Great Blue Mandelbrot](great-blue-mandelbrot)" fractal map. If you're drawn especially into the spiral, however, then my legendary "[Heart of the Rose](heart-of-the-rose)" fractal mural or subtle "[Mother of Pearl](mother-of-pearl)" design would call you into them. The "Nocturne of Scorpio" appeared as a feature in my "[Spectral Iteration](spectral-iteration)" fractal book alongside many of these other icons.
